difference_interval: pointwise paired seed Student t 95%, df=23; no multiplicity adjustment
event_interval: Wilson 95% by seed; mean capped times include non-events at administrative horizon
objective: pure MSE + 0.02 * activations after initialization / common scored decisions; all activations through horizon priced
recovery: two consecutive complete nonoverlapping 10-decision blocks with MSE no greater than 1.5 times own pre-change MSE; observed at last arrival; missing is censored
factorial: 18 vs 45 initial observations chosen as last arrived by warmup, subsequent 1-or-3 vs 35 extra ticks after target end; same warmup release schedule and same generated feature/target path; training uses observed prefix only
